● Minecraft meets Cookie Clicker
● Craft inventions & Discover recipes

~~~~~~~~~
~HONORS~
~~~~~~~~~

● Most updated iOS game of 2016. (61 times)
● Mash of 6 genres: RPG, Puzzle, Incremental, Adventure, Unfolding, Crafting
● Most of our players play 20+ hours, are you one of them?
● “You've never played anything like Dawn of Crafting!” -Notch
● Featured on the App Store multiple times

~~~~~~~~
~STORY~
~~~~~~~~

You are a lost young Homo Sapien whose village was destroyed by the Homo Erectus. Master Crafter Alf, takes you as his apprentice and teaches you the fine art of crafting. You learn everything you can, increase your skills, discover new recipes and craft a lot of items. You build a village one stick at a time and further progress humankind. But some forces will stand in the way of your progress...

~~~~~~~~~~~
~Community~
~~~~~~~~~~~

Dawn of Crafting has an active & loving community where you can share strategies, discover hidden features, design new features for the devs and make new friends all over the world. Join us on Touch Arcade & Reddit, links below.

~~~~~~~~~~~
~FEATURES~
~~~~~~~~~~~

 ◆ NO ADS & NO IAP REQUIRED 
We both hate that stuff.

 ◆ GUARANTEED MONEY RETURN
If you’re not satisfied, we’re not satisfied.

 ◆ OFFLINE SINGLE PLAYER
Play in your subway and toilet!

 ◆ INFINITE REPLAYABILITY
Prestige and keep going!

 ◆ CASUAL & HARDCORE
Play at your own pace or craft like a madman!

 ◆ USE LOGIC & INTUITION
Average people may run out of brain RAM.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
~DOWNLOAD NOW!~
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Download now and start crafting! See how civilization progresses with new updates!

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

We’ve been working on Dawn of Crafting for 1.5 years with my brother. We’ve just launched version 1.0 and its being featured in a lot of countries on the App Store. It hit #1 RPG in a few countries like Sweden and #2 in UK.

We're also part of YC's Startup School.

Its built completely by using Native Swift and the library EZSwiftExtensions. Feel free to ask any questions regarding development.

This game is for people who like to craft. If you enjoy ancient themes and building humanity from nothing into a great civilization hands on, then Dawn of Crafting is for you.

quotes.text:
## Resource Management Skill

Resource management is the efficient and effective usage of resources. Each individual has a certain level as well as organizations. Those aware of their skill level tend to hoard their resources while those not aware tend to waste it. A good example will be people who win the lottery. Their income & networth usually defaults back to where ever their skill was.

On the other hand some notable companies such as Google, Facebook, Apple tend to be aware of their resource management skill thus they hoard the extra resources instead of wasting it.

Other notable people could be Asian grandparents. But too much hoarding is also not a good way to manage resources.

## How To Increase?

I'm working on a web game called colonist.io. We have gotten pretty far on the web and it's time to create a mobile version. Some people tell us that if we get an outsourcing firm to make the mobile it'll speed us up. We know that an outsourcing firm will make the wrong product and on average will make it 3.8 star and best case scenario 4.4, not 4.9. That is our standard as can be seen from our [previous game](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dawn-of-crafting/id1067104191) and we don't want to lower our standard just to be able to spend more money.

There are some amazing people who can just deploy the resources to create all of this. There are also other people who raise millions multiple times throughout the years and waste all of them.

"just do it and you'll learn it" …
